title: I’m 14 years old and I wanna get into coding a video game please help
author: Amazing_Client_1795
selftext: Look when I grow up I wanna make a really good rpg and I wanna have the skills to make that rpg and the thing is all I know what to do is to code on scratch but I want more freedom with my games and stuff i don’t have a computer so Im stuck on an iPad so I was wondering if there are any websites I can learn to code or can you guys give me advice and help me learn to code

comments.author: Living_Cell7304
comments.body: You need to look at real tutorials that explain why you’re typing these things, and what they mean. Not just copying random shit and expecting to learn something.
